row.name: Mativ Holdings Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=30 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=1 giveback=0.29 tightness=0.78 base_volume_vs_leg=0.74 base_volume_vs_avg=0.87
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 30 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 4.5% vs its 20-SMA, 1.5% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 1 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The VOL check is a recorded FAIL: the base exceeds 21 sessions so a catalyst-volume rule applies, requiring at least 1.5x the 50-session average, but volume came in at only 1.25x average with a rank of 10 out of 60 — well short of the threshold. The base itself is 30 sessions, outside Bonde's 3–20 window, and the chart shows a wide, choppy consolidation from late September through early November with multiple overlapping red and green bars spanning roughly $1.60 of range, confirming the PARTIAL C reading. The signal bar is clean (close_pos 0.96, closed above open), but the weak volume and loose extended base are the decisive quality drags.
claude.key_risk: Volume failed the catalyst-volume requirement for a long base, and the 30-session consolidation is outside the ideal window with visible choppiness, reducing the probability of a sustained follow-through burst.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the signal close of $12.10 by more than 1% or if the first 30 minutes show a fade back below the prior day's close near $11.17.
